pins.title: Osprey Season on the Chesapeake: A Dock at Dawn
pins.description: Osprey season on the Chesapeake runs March into September, and a dock at dawn is the best seat for it. What you hear before you see it, and when the birds head south.
pins.altText: An osprey over a tidal creek on Virginia's Northern Neck at first light.

pins.title: Birding Virginia's Northern Neck: Osprey, Heron, Eagle
pins.description: Birding on Virginia's Northern Neck: osprey diving the shallows, a great blue heron standing still for an hour, bald eagles on the thermals, kingfishers working the bank.
pins.altText: A quiet Chesapeake tributary at sunrise, seen from a private dock.

pins.title: What a Morning on a Tidal Creek Sounds Like
pins.description: The creek at dawn on Virginia's Northern Neck: an osprey's descending call carrying across flat water, dew on the dock planks, twenty minutes before real light arrives.
pins.altText: Sunrise over a brackish tidal creek off the Potomac River.
